from pyspark.sql.functions import explode, col, lit, input_file_name
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, LongType, BooleanType
import os
from notebookutils import mssparkutils  # Azure Synapse specific utility

# Directory paths
input_directory = "abfss://synapse@dudodatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/stagingBORK/masterdata"
output_base = "abfss://synapse@dudodatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/outputBORK/masterdata"
temp_location = "abfss://synapse@dudodatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/outputBORK/temp"

# Define file patterns to search for
file_patterns = [
    {
        "pattern": "*centers*.json",
        "output_name": "centers",
        "description": "Centers"
    },
    {
        "pattern": "*paymodegrouplist*.json",
        "output_name": "paymodegrouplist",
        "description": "Payment Modes"
    },
    {
        "pattern": "*productgrouplist*.json",
        "output_name": "productgrouplist", 
        "description": "Products"
    },
    {
        "pattern": "*users*.json",
        "output_name": "users",
        "description": "Users"
    }
]

# Track processed files for cleanup
processed_files = []

# Main execution block
try:
    print("Starting masterdata file processing...")
    
    # Process each file pattern
    for pattern_info in file_patterns:
        pattern = pattern_info["pattern"]
        output_name = pattern_info["output_name"]  # Just use the base output name directly
        description = pattern_info["description"]
        
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Processing {description} files with pattern: {pattern}")
        
        # Find files matching the pattern
        files_df = spark.read.format("binaryFile") \
                       .option("pathGlobFilter", pattern) \
                       .load(input_directory) \
                       .select(input_file_name().alias("path"))
        
        # Check if any files were found
        file_count = files_df.count()
        if file_count == 0:
            print(f"No {description} files found matching pattern {pattern}")
            continue
            
        print(f"Found {file_count} matching file(s)")
        
        # Process each file matching the pattern
        for row in files_df.collect():
            file_path = row.path
            file_name = os.path.basename(file_path)
            
            # Define output paths - use simple output name without date
            final_output = f"{output_base}/{output_name}.parquet"
            temp_output = f"{temp_location}/{output_name}_temp"
            
            print(f"\n{'-'*40}")
            print(f"Processing: {file_name}")
            print(f"Output will be: {final_output}")
            
            try:
                # Check if the final output file already exists and delete it if needed
                try:
                    if mssparkutils.fs.exists(final_output):
                        mssparkutils.fs.rm(final_output, True)
                        print(f"Removed existing file: {final_output}")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Warning when checking/removing existing file: {str(e)}")
                
                # Make sure temp directory is clean
                if mssparkutils.fs.exists(temp_output):
                    mssparkutils.fs.rm(temp_output, True)
                    print(f"Cleaned up existing temp directory: {temp_output}")
                
                # Read the JSON file
                df = spark.read.option("multiline", "true").json(file_path)
                
                # Check if data array exists and has elements
                if "data" not in df.columns or df.select("data").first()[0] is None or len(df.select("data").first()[0]) == 0:
                    print(f"Skipping file {file_name}: Empty data array")
                    continue
                
                # Process the file - explode data array and select all columns from each item
                processed_df = (df
                    # Explode the data array into separate rows
                    .select(explode("data").alias("item"))
                    
                    # Add the source file name column
                    .withColumn("SourceFileName", lit(file_name))
                )
                
                # Select all fields from the item
                columns = processed_df.select("item.*").columns
                select_expr = ["SourceFileName"]
                
                # Add all item fields to select expression
                for col_name in columns:
                    select_expr.append(f"item.{col_name} as {col_name}")
                
                processed_df = processed_df.selectExpr(*select_expr)
                
                # Show schema and count
                print(f"Schema of processed data:")
                processed_df.printSchema()
                
                row_count = processed_df.count()
                print(f"Total records: {row_count}")
                
                # Write to temporary location as a single file
                processed_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").parquet(temp_output)
                
                # Find the part file in the temp directory
                part_files = mssparkutils.fs.ls(temp_output)
                parquet_part_file = next((f for f in part_files if f.name.startswith("part-") and f.name.endswith(".parquet")), None)
                
                if parquet_part_file:
                    # Move the file to the final location with overwrite=True
                    mssparkutils.fs.mv(f"{temp_output}/{parquet_part_file.name}", final_output, True, True)
                    
                    # Clean up temp directory
                    mssparkutils.fs.rm(temp_output, True)
                    
                    print(f"Successfully processed and wrote file to: {final_output}")
                    
                    # Verify the output file
                    verify_df = spark.read.parquet(final_output)
                    verify_count = verify_df.count()
                    print(f"Verified output file {final_output} with {verify_count} records")
                    
                    if verify_count == row_count:
                        print(f"✓ Conversion successful for {description}!")
                        # Add to processed files list for cleanup
                        processed_files.append(file_path)
                    else:
                        print(f"⚠ Warning: Record count mismatch for {description}!")
                else:
                    print(f"Error: No part file found in {temp_output}")
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error processing file {file_name}: {str(e)}")
                import traceback
                traceback.print_exc()  # Print full stack trace for debugging
                
                # Clean up temp directory in case of error
                try:
                    if mssparkutils.fs.exists(temp_output):
                        mssparkutils.fs.rm(temp_output, True)
                except:
                    pass
    
    # Clean up only the processed files, not the directory itself
    print("\nCleaning up processed files...")
    
    # Delete each successfully processed file
    for file_path in processed_files:
        try:
            if mssparkutils.fs.exists(file_path):
                mssparkutils.fs.rm(file_path, False)  # False to not recursively delete
                print(f"Deleted processed file: {file_path}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warning when deleting file {file_path}: {str(e)}")
    
    # Report on remaining files
    try:
        remaining_files = mssparkutils.fs.ls(input_directory)
        remaining_count = len(remaining_files)
        
        if remaining_count == 0:
            print("All files processed and removed from staging directory")
        else:
            print(f"Note: {remaining_count} files remain in the staging directory.")
            print("These files were either not matched by any pattern or had processing errors.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Warning when checking directory {input_directory}: {str(e)}")
    
    print("\nAll processing complete!")
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error in main execution: {str(e)}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()  # Print full stack trace for debugging
